OPT EAD, GC EAD, GC, TN and Citizens Only 
 
 Hi Friends, 
 Hope you are doing great, 
 
 I have an urgent requirement from one of my esteem client, I will appreciate if you can have an eye on the below requirement and send me your consultant updated profile ASAP. 
 
 Role: EDI Claims / .NET Developer 
 Work Location: Boise, Idaho 
 Duration: 6-12 months 
 
 Top Skills: 
 1. 1- 3 years of hands-on, recent , custom EDI claims transactions development (they are not looking for candidates who have used 3rd party tools for EDI integrations) 
 2. Strong .NET ( software programming and analysis ) development 
 3. Multiple years in Healthcare-industry 
 4. X12 Healthcare EDI transaction sets – NICE TO HAVE 
 
 Full Job Description 
 Knowledge of: 
 · HIPAA regulations and healthcare administration functions, including claims processing, eligibility verification and preauthorization. 
 · Relational databases, SQL and database access interfaces (ODBC, JDBC, ADO, ADO.NET) 
 · Software testing procedures 
 · Network and software architecture 
 · Build automation 
 · Version control software 
 
 Skills: 
 · Advanced experience and database-related development (reading and writing complex SQL queries and stored procedures, etc.) 
 · Advanced experience in developing applications to consume web services 
 · Intermediate experience in .NET (C#) software development 
 · Intermediate experience reading and writing XML 
 · Strong analytical and problem solving 
 · Detail-oriented 
 · Excellent written and verbal communication 
 · Continuous integration, automated build and deployment 
 · Visual Studio, MS .NET Framework, C# 
 
 Ability to: 
 
 PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS: 
 
 · Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Systems or related technical field. 
 · Experience working within Agile/Scrum methodology 
 · Experience with Team Foundation Server (TFS) 
 · X12 Healthcare Electronic Data Interchange (EDI) transaction sets 
 · Experience with transactional and real-time based systems 
 · Knowledge of MQ technologies 


 If my requirement matches your resume, then please do reply on my email id alih (at) usmsystems(dot)com  and contact no is 703-955-3955
